title: US FTC sues to block Nvidia's USD 40 billion purchase of Arm on competition grounds
summary: The Federal Trade Commission filed a challenge to the acquisition of the chip-design firm from SoftBank.

title: DeepMind publishes Gopher, a 280-billion-parameter language model, with an analysis of ethical risks and a retrieval model
summary: DeepMind's post covers language modelling at scale, the ethical considerations it identified and a retrieval-based approach.

title: Baidu and Pengcheng Laboratory release ERNIE 3.0 Titan, a 260-billion-parameter Chinese language model
summary: The article describes it as the largest Chinese monolithic model to date, trained on Pengcheng Cloudbrain II with PaddlePaddle, and reports top results on more than 60 tasks.

title: US Treasury adds SenseTime to its list of Chinese military-industrial complex companies, restricting US investment
summary: Securities Times reports the listing of 10 December restricts US persons from trading SenseTime's publicly traded securities.

title: SenseTime postpones its Hong Kong IPO after the US Treasury listing
summary: The company announced the delay on 13 December and said subscription funds would be refunded without interest.

title: LG AI Research unveils EXAONE, a roughly 300-billion-parameter multimodal 'super-giant' AI model
summary: LG presents its large multimodal model trained on text and images, to be used across LG affiliates and partners.

title: France's data regulator says Clearview AI breached privacy law and orders it to stop collecting and delete data
summary: Reuters coverage carried by Malay Mail reports the CNIL finding against the facial-recognition company on 16 December.

title: UN weapons-treaty review conference ends without a mandate to negotiate on autonomous weapons, Human Rights Watch says
summary: HRW says states agreed only a vague mandate to consider proposals on lethal autonomous weapons in 2022, and names Russia, the United States, India and Israel as the main obstacles.

title: Alexa suggested a 10-year-old touch a coin to a partly plugged-in charger; Amazon says it updated the assistant
summary: The girl's mother posted the exchange on Twitter, and Amazon told the BBC it had updated Alexa so it no longer suggests such actions.
